posts.name: Video Editor by Panda Video
posts.tagline: Video hosting and editing in one place
posts.description: Your courses and VSLs are already hosted on Panda Video. Now you can edit them there too. Cut a wrong take, update an offer or add subtitles, then save over the original. The video stays live and every embed shows the new version. Available on Gold and Enterprise plans.

posts.name: nRouter
posts.tagline: LLM Gateway & AI Guardrails for Teams
posts.description: Enterprise LLM gateway with active AI guardrails, deterministic smart routing, and token budget enforcement, included on every multi-tenant cloud account.

posts.name: Jumpcade
posts.tagline: Free browser games, plus one daily game for everyone
posts.description: Jumpcade is a free browser games site: play instantly, with no download and no account, and come back for one daily game picked for everyone.

posts.name: Huahai
posts.tagline: An iPhone guide to looking closely at paintings
posts.description: Start with one detail in a painting. Tap to see how a shadow, a gesture, or a change in color shapes the whole picture. Huahai connects those observations to guided readings, artists, and a Western art history timeline. The iPhone app is free to download and use, with artwork notes and guides in nine languages.

posts.name: California DMV Prep 2026
posts.tagline: Free California DMV permit practice tests
posts.description: Prepare for the California DMV written permit test with 20 full mock exams of 20 questions each, covering California road rules, signs, and safe driving. Mock Exams 1–7 are free, with no sign-up needed.

posts.name: Life Timeline
posts.tagline: See your whole life, and your family's time together
posts.description: Life Timeline is a free tool that draws your whole life year by year from just your birth date. Add your parents, partner and kids, and see the time you have together on one timeline. No sign-up, and your inputs aren't stored on the server.

posts.name: CallTuv Callback Widget
posts.tagline: Free callback widget that turns visitors into phone calls
posts.description: Add a callback button to any website with one line of code. Visitors leave their number (plus name, email or a message if you ask), and every request lands in one Leads list with the time where they are. Call them back from your browser in one click, at normal CallTuv rates from $0.03/min. The owner gets an email for each request, a lead webhook brings in leads from Zapier, Make or your own forms.

posts.name: AIDE AI
posts.tagline: AI grader for handwritten Cambridge & Edexcel papers
posts.description: AIDE AI is an AI grader for teachers, schools and academies. Upload handwritten or typed student work, including essays, and AIDE AI marks it against Cambridge IGCSE, O Level, AS & A Level and Edexcel mark schemes, drafts feedback, and the teacher approves every mark. Students practise past papers from a library of about 60,000 Cambridge, Pearson Edexcel and BISE questions, tagged by topic, with answers. Free: 50 pages, no credit card, plus a free grade calculator and worksheet builder.

posts.name: GeoCalendar
posts.tagline: A booking page that offers the times with the least driving
posts.description: GeoCalendar is a booking page for teams that drive to their customers. Customers enter their address, then pick from the times next to your other visits, each showing the driving it saves. The calendar blocks the drive between visits, the map shows each day's route, and on the Team plan your HubSpot, Pipedrive, Attio or LeadConnector contacts appear as pins you can book from. Two-way sync with Google Calendar and Outlook. 14-day free trial, no card.

posts.name: Photo to Line Drawing
posts.tagline: Turn photos into editable SVG line art & printable PDFs
posts.description: Convert photos into clean line art — no pencil shading. One credit unlocks editable SVG paths, 300 DPI PNG, and print-ready A4/US Letter PDFs (plus 10-page coloring books with covers). 3 free previews; non-expiring packs start at $6.90 for 150 images.

posts.name: ProDocs
posts.tagline: Evidence-backed docs and context for coding agents
posts.description: ProDocs is a local-first, Apache-2.0 tool that links documentation to the code and tests behind it. Generate docs with traceable evidence, catch stale docs in CI, and see which features, tests, and runbooks a change affects. Give coding agents scoped repo context through the CLI or MCP. The core runs without an AI model or hosted service.

posts.name: SnapTube APK
posts.tagline: Baixe o SnapTube APK para Android
posts.description: Descubra informações sobre o SnapTube APK para Android. Conheça seus recursos, aprenda como baixar vídeos e músicas de diferentes plataformas e confira orientações de instalação, formatos compatíveis e dicas para aproveitar melhor o aplicativo.

posts.name: Spin the bottle
posts.tagline: Decision-maker for parties, and truth-or-dare, 🍾✨
posts.description: Bring a classic back to life with a modern, digital twist! Whether you’re hosting a virtual game night, settling a friendly debate, or just need a random picker that feels more exciting than a static list, Spin the Bottle delivers a smooth, high-fidelity experience. We’ve traded the glass shards for a sleek, interactive interface designed for modern browsers. No more lopsided spins on the carpet—just pure, physics-based randomness.

posts.name: Klenny
posts.tagline: Lock your keyboard and trackpad while you clean your Mac
posts.description: Wiping a MacBook keyboard can wake it up, type gibberish or click things. Klenny locks your keyboard and trackpad from the menu bar while you clean. Each key turns green as you wipe it, and pressing Esc three times unlocks everything. Native, with no account or tracking in the app. Your first cleaning is free, then it's a one-time US$4.99 for up to 3 Macs.

posts.name: Lumè CRM
posts.tagline: Built for med spas, not borrowed from salons
posts.description: The operating system for modern med spas. Booking, client charts, e-signed consent, payments, an AI SMS agent, marketing and a full reporting suite in one HIPAA-ready platform, with a BAA on every plan.
